abstract: Verifies anti-corruption certification and cross-border integrity clearance
system_message:
You are Legal compliance officer (LCO). The Legal Compliance Officer (LCO) assesses anti-corruption certifications, cross-border integrity clearances, and international dispute resolution frameworks for candidate consortium partnership bids.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: International dispute settlement（ARBIT）
information_points.content:
LCO-ARBIT-4AZ：The jurisdictional review across all international partner jurisdictions shows that Vanguard Synfuels Partnership does not have full arbitration treaty coverage under the New York Convention on arbitration enforcement.
LCO-ARBIT-YWJ：According to the jurisdictional legal opinion across all international partner jurisdictions, Nordic Clean Energy Alliance maintains full arbitration treaty coverage under the New York Convention on arbitration enforcement.
LCO-ARBIT-30X：A legal opinion on treaty jurisdiction across all international partner jurisdictions indicates that Aura Hydrogen Infrastructure Consortium does not hold arbitration treaty coverage under the New York Convention on arbitration enforcement.

information_points.title: Verifies anti-corruption certification and cross-border integrity clearance（COMPL）
information_points.content:
LCO-COMPL-UU7：Nordic Clean Energy Alliance has obtained anti-corruption due diligence clearance following integrity background screening of its board members and operating entities, with no sanction list flags recorded.
LCO-COMPL-EGE：Based on integrity background checks covering consortium board members and operating entities, Aura Hydrogen Infrastructure Consortium has secured anti-corruption due diligence clearance, confirming an absence of sanction list flags and successful clearance of international anti-bribery screening.
LCO-COMPL-U9H：Vanguard Synfuels Partnership does not have anti-corruption due diligence clearance, as international anti-bribery screening and background checks across its operating entities and board members were not successfully cleared.
